display.purpose: Page titles only, condensed (wdth 72), over a strong rule. 2.25rem mobile, 3rem from md.

headline.purpose: Section and report titles inside cards (wdth 80).

body.purpose: UI and prose, tabular numerals on; measure 60-72ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase metadata: table headers, small section headings, status words, doc types. Colour ink-3.

serial.purpose: Courier Prime for serials, IDs, IOCs, model names, tool I/O.

indicator.purpose: The IOC input on the request slip.

shadows.name: cross-reference-lift
shadows.purpose: Only on the source card matching a hovered or focused S-n chip, with translateY(-2px) and a 2px ink/60 ring.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing: file-in, tab and chip lift, ticker.

motion.name: file-in
motion.purpose: New cards, rows and expanded panels drop and settle.

motion.name: tick
motion.purpose: Only the changed characters of an in-place metric.

motion.name: rule-run
motion.purpose: Ink bar along the top rule of the working agent card.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover colour changes and cross-reference lift.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses every animation and transition.

narrative.overview:
ThreatRAG is drawn as a mid-century signals-intelligence card index. Everything the system produces (an answer, a retrieved passage, an agent's work, a saved report, a tool call) is a filed card with a serial: `S-1`, `AG-2`, `A-1`, `L-3`, `Q-1`, `R-7E41C0`. Citations are cross-references: an `S-n` chip in the prose and the tabbed source card it points to light each other on hover or focus. The shell is a filing-cabinet green rail; the work surface is card stock on a darker card-stock ground in light mode, and cabinet-interior charcoal green in dark.

Structure comes from rules, not boxes or shadows: a 3px ink rule across the top of a card, 1px rules between rows, coloured index tabs protruding above card tops. Colour is signal ink, used on tabs, chips, stamps and state words, never as a wash. Density is that of a working tool: compact rows, mono identifiers, tabular numerals everywhere. The world refuses the near-black neon SOC console: no glow, no glass, no gradient.
keyCharacteristics: Every artifact carries a serial in Courier Prime; one serial system across the app.
Cards are flat card stock with a heavy top rule; coloured tabs protrude above them.
Four signal inks with fixed meanings: vermilion, cobalt, ochre, cabinet green.
Archivo at condensed width (wdth 72-80) for headings, normal width for UI text.
Magnitude shown as a five-hole punch row, not a bar or a percentage alone.
Square corners everywhere except the 2px cross-reference chip and the round punch holes.

rules.name: The Fixed Ink Rule
rules.body: Each signal ink means one thing everywhere: vermilion is critical and the Critic, cobalt is the Researcher and ATT&CK, ochre is the Reporter and OWASP, green is success. Never use a signal ink decoratively or reassign it.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Only the primary submit on a page is filled vermilion. Everything else is a line or text button.

rules.name: The Typewriter Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime sets only machine identity: serials, IDs, IOCs, hashes, model names, tool I/O, keyboard hints. Never prose, never buttons, never headings.

rules.name: The Condensed Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings use Archivo condensed (wdth 72 for display, 80 for headline/title) at 800; never set a heading in a different family.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat at rest. Lift appears only as the answer to a cross-reference, never as decoration or hover polish.

dos: Do give every new artifact a mono serial in the existing system (`S-n`, `AG-n`, `A-n`, `L-n`, `Q-n`, `R-XXXXXX`).
Do build structure from rules: a 3px strong top rule on filed cards, 1px rules between rows and panes.
Do mark a card's type with a protruding 56 x 10px index tab in its signal ink.
Do show relevance or counts with the five-hole punch row, paired with the exact number.
Do define every colour as an RGB-channel custom property with light and dark values, and reference it through the Tailwind token.
Do keep text at ink-3 or darker on card stock in both themes.
donts: Don't use glow, glassmorphism, gradients or neon-on-black panels; this is not a SOC console.
Don't round cards, buttons or fields; only the cross-reference chip (2px) and holes are curved.
Don't add resting shadows; the cross-reference lift is the only shadow.
Don't fill a second button with vermilion on the same view.
Don't set prose, buttons or headings in Courier Prime, or IDs and IOCs in Archivo.
Don't redact or escape indicators of compromise in display; only credential formats are redacted.
